title: Selectable UI themes — light + tan, cookie-remembered

Q1.decision: Settings ⚙ → UI pane (existing). Theme swatches at the top, above closed-sessions / dotfiles.
Q1.question: Where does the picker live?
Q1.rec: Settings ⚙ → UI pane (existing). Theme swatches at the top, above closed-sessions / dotfiles.

Q2.decision: dark (current look, default) + light + tan. Three ids in v1. No system / custom / high-contrast yet.
Q2.question: v1 catalog?
Q2.rec: dark (current look, default) + light + tan. Three ids in v1. No system / custom / high-contrast yet.

Q3.decision: Cookie marble_theme. Not localStorage, not SQLite, not mixed into marble.ui.prefs.
Q3.question: Persistence?
Q3.rec: Cookie marble_theme. Not localStorage, not SQLite, not mixed into marble.ui.prefs.

Q4.decision: Path=/; Max-Age=31536000 (1 year); SameSite=Lax; Secure only when location.protocol is https; not HttpOnly; host-only (no Domain).
Q4.question: Cookie attributes?
Q4.rec: Path=/; Max-Age=31536000 (1 year); SameSite=Lax; Secure only when location.protocol is https; not HttpOnly; host-only (no Domain).

Q5.decision: Live apply + write cookie immediately on swatch click. Settings Save is not required for theme.
Q5.question: Apply timing?
Q5.rec: Live apply + write cookie immediately on swatch click. Settings Save is not required for theme.

Q6.decision: Inline boot script in index.html <head> before the stylesheet. Sets html[data-theme] and color-scheme from the cookie.
Q6.question: How do we avoid a flash of the wrong theme?
Q6.rec: Inline boot script in index.html <head> before the stylesheet. Sets html[data-theme] and color-scheme from the cookie.

Q7.decision: html[data-theme='dark|light|tan'] CSS variables. :root stays dark. Retokenize hardcoded chrome hex in style.css — leftover hex is a bug.
Q7.question: Token architecture?
Q7.rec: html[data-theme='dark|light|tan'] CSS variables. :root stays dark. Retokenize hardcoded chrome hex in style.css — leftover hex is a bug.

Q8.decision: No in v1. Explicit pick only. Default dark. A later system id can follow prefers-color-scheme.
Q8.question: Follow OS prefers-color-scheme?
Q8.rec: No in v1. Explicit pick only. Default dark. A later system id can follow prefers-color-scheme.

Q9.decision: Three swatch cards (mini bg/panel/accent strip + id). Not a <select>.
Q9.question: Selector widget?
Q9.rec: Three swatch cards (mini bg/panel/accent strip + id). Not a <select>.

Q10.decision: Embedded web SPA only (index.html + style.css + settings.js). Not ADR pages, mpub, Wonderstand, or desktop peer.
Q10.question: Which surfaces?
Q10.rec: Embedded web SPA only (index.html + style.css + settings.js). Not ADR pages, mpub, Wonderstand, or desktop peer.

Q11.decision: UI-section Reset does not change theme. Picking dark is how you go back. Theme is not a marble.ui.prefs draft field.
Q11.question: Settings Reset vs theme?
Q11.rec: UI-section Reset does not change theme. Picking dark is how you go back. Theme is not a marble.ui.prefs draft field.

Q12.decision: Lock token names + proposed hex tables in the ADR. Contrast tweaks at implement are allowed. No fourth theme id without a follow-on ADR.
Q12.question: How locked are the palettes?
Q12.rec: Lock token names + proposed hex tables in the ADR. Contrast tweaks at implement are allowed. No fourth theme id without a follow-on ADR.
